name: Dev Pages

sources.title: Submit a Developer Tool — free hand-reviewed form

requirements: Must be a developer tool — directory categories span DevOps, cloud, observability, APIs, frameworks, databases, security, testing, AI/ML, etc.
Every submission is read by hand; listings are free
preparation: Category from their list (Generative AI, AI/ML, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Observability, APIs, Frameworks, Databases, Security, Finance Tools, Learning, Design, No-Code, Productivity, Testing, Mobile, Data & Analytics, CMS, Version Control, Documentation, AI Agents)
Pricing model, GitHub URL (optional), comma-separated tags
Your email (used only to notify acceptance)
workflow: Fill all required fields (name, description, URL, category, pricing, email)
Leave the honeypot field empty ('Leave this field empty' / 'If you are human, leave this field blank')
Submit and wait for manual review and an email verdict
watchFor: Honeypot field: any content in it likely flags the submission as bot spam
GitHub URL is optional — the rest of the required fields must all be filled
No account needed; no payment anywhere on the form
countsAsLive: Tool appears on devpages.io under its category page and in Explore
